scores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 functional with substantial friction; 7 good with noticeable friction; 10 exceptional and consistently clear within assessed scope. Scores are holistic judgments of observed touch-emulated interaction, not calculated from wins, accuracy or mission score.

reasons.overall_mobile: A coherent complete mission with useful touch assistance, attractive atmosphere and clear progress feedback; precise combat reading and control framing introduce friction.
reasons.controls: Large labeled targets, working MOVE, target taps, AIM zoom, FIRE drag and route/fire combination. Small drag sample and moving framing made aim reliability hard to judge. Full manual navigation and ergonomics unassessed.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery, coils and upload provide an understandable progression with threats and reload tradeoffs. Two assisted runs support mission coherence, not deep combat or replay enjoyment claims.
reasons.presentation: Strong cyan/amber industrial atmosphere, rain, coherent typography, satisfying visible target and objective feedback. Audio and hardware rendering quality unassessed.
reasons.usability: Handbook, persistent objectives, route/approach assistance, planning map and explicit START FRESH help. Multiple prompts and threat/route/aim interactions require attention.
reasons.readability: Main buttons and health/ammo are legible at 844x390; small enemies, low-contrast geometry, world labels and overlapping announcement/threat banners are harder to parse.

coverage: FIRE hold and small FIRE drag
helpful: Handbook explained touch controls and mission sequence.
Large labeled controls, target-down/coil-off and memory-saved feedback.
Route and approach reduced navigation uncertainty; map showed 23m route to extraction.
frustrating: TURN plus route/fire did not always keep target centered; spent rounds without clear hit feedback.
Dense HUD and dark small enemies; announcements overlap view.

uncertainties: No AIM, DASH, JUMP or TOOLS coverage yet.
Assisted completion does not establish manual navigation or sustained fine aim quality.
failures: No terminal failure. Missed/covered firing and reload interruption preserved in captures.

attempts.fresh_start: Visible START FRESH tapped after first terminal result was saved to this report.
coverage: Target tap + AIM + FIRE; zoomed live screenshot, then ordinary pause cleared AIM.
Manual MOVE diagonally forward with DASH and JUMP taps. DASH cooldown 2.1 visible; transient jump motion not established by capture.
Simultaneous ROUTE and FIRE with small FIRE drag
Three numbered coil target taps and firing; automatic reload
helpful: AIM visibly enlarged sight picture and first guard went down.
Memory saved and coil OFF/percentage feedback made objective progress clear.
Prior knowledge of holding approach and waiting for reload made mission sequence understandable.
frustrating: Moving target tap plus ROUTE/FIRE drag ended with NO IMPACT; expenditure of ammunition without clear sustained tracking.
First coil stopped at 37% during reload; rear threats competed with frontal objective.
Small enemies behind cover and broad dark/gray geometry made precise target reading difficult.
failures: No terminal failure. Some firing returned COVER, INERT COVER or NO IMPACT. These are observed feedback, not proof of a defect.
uncertainties: DASH and JUMP were sampled, not validated for evasion or vaulting.
No TOOLS selection, scene swipe, AIM drag, manual full mission navigation, recovered memory reading, settings adjustment, or physical ergonomics assessed.
Only short FIRE drags sampled; sustained fine aim and continuous combat remain uncertain.
